public_rationale: Marcus says SpaceX will never match Amazon's 2,538x return, which he says would mean a market value of about $4,442 trillion. He set no deadline. SpaceX listed on June 12, 2026, at a market value of about $2 trillion. Nothing by the evaluation date comes close to a 2,538x return, so nothing has proved him wrong. But a 'never' claim cannot be confirmed early. The forecast stays open.
limitations: Only the debut-day market value was checked. Later price moves do not matter unless they approach 2,538x.
